question: Operating system of a computer is an example of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**System software**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• An operating system (OS) is a type of **system software** that acts as an interface between the user and the computer hardware.
 
• The primary function of system software, including the OS, is to manage the hardware components and provide a platform for running application software.
 
• Examples of operating systems include Microsoft Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
 
• Operating systems perform essential tasks such as managing memory, processes, hardware devices, and file systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **System Software:**

 
 
• System software is designed to provide a platform for other software. Examples include operating systems, utility software, and device drivers.
 
• It is crucial for the system's overall functioning and helps manage hardware resources.
 
• System software operates at a basic level, enabling the functioning of application software and hardware interactions.
 
 
 
• **Application Software:**
 
 
• Application software is designed to help users perform specific tasks. Examples include word processors, spreadsheets, and web browsers.
 
• It runs on top of system software and provides user-centric functionalities.
 
• Application software is generally more user-friendly and task-specific compared to system software.
 
 
 
• **Hardware:**
 
 
• Hardware refers to the physical components of a computer system, such as the CPU, memory devices, and input/output devices.
 
• Hardware components are managed by system software to execute various tasks.
 
• Without hardware, software would have no platform to run on, making it an essential part of a computer system.
